intuition.title: Why N-acylimidazoles?
intuition.summary: The paper describes Cd–thiolate clusters as sensitive to acid/base conditions, heat, oxidation and competing sulfur chemistry. It selects N-acylimidazoles, used for phenolic tyrosine tagging in reference 9, to transfer acyl groups under mild conditions. Successful short-time derivatization and failures under direct-acyl-chloride or prolonged treatment support a limited reaction window; they do not identify a complete kinetic mechanism.
intuition.scope: Source discussion; interpretation and cited context are distinguished in the text.
